register_message: register a protobuf message type in the SymbolDatabase for later lookup by symbol name
register_file_descriptor: register a protobuf file descriptor in the SymbolDatabase to make all its messages available
get_symbol: get a registered protobuf message class by its full symbol name from the SymbolDatabase
get_messages: get all registered message classes from specified protobuf file names as a dictionary
default_database: get the default SymbolDatabase instance shared across the protobuf runtime
